```{python}
import cellrank as cr
import scanpy as sc
import session_info2
from cellrank.kernels import RealTimeKernel
from moscot.problems.time import TemporalProblem
import scvelo as scv
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sc.set_figure_params(frameon=False, dpi=100)
cr.settings.logging_level = "INFO"
```

# cellrank using time-course as input
```{python}
cars = sc.read("4_car_no_gd_psuedotime.h5ad")
to_remove = ["Product Mixed T", "Product CD8+ T", "Cycling T"]
cars = cars[~cars.obs["labels"].isin(to_remove)].copy()
```

```{python}
cars.obs["labels"] = cars.obs["labels"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
```

```{python}
label_palette = {
    "CM CD8+ T":"darkred",
    "Activated CM CD8+ T":"mediumvioletred",
    "DN T":"springgreen",
    "Cycling T":"skyblue",
    "DN/CD8+ T":"forestgreen",
    "Naive/CM T":"deepskyblue",
    "Activated Naive/CM T":"blue",
    "Product CD8+ T":"grey",
    "GD/CD8+ T":"gold",
    "EM CD8+ T":"red",
    "Early EM CD8+ T":"indianred",
    "Myeloid contamination":"tan",
    "Product Mixed T":"black",
    "Exhausted/Late EM CD8+ T":"darkorchid"
}
```

```{python}
time_numeric = {
    #"M0":0,
    "M01":1,
    "M02":2,
    "M03":3,
    "M04":4,
    "M05":5,
    "M06":6,
    "M09":9,
    "M12":12,
    "M14":14,
    "M15":15,
    "M18":18,
    "M21":21,
    "M30":30,
    "M36":36,
    "M48":48,
    "M60":60,    

}

cars.obs["timepoint_numeric"] = (
    cars.obs["Timepoint"]
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .map(time_numeric)
    .astype(float)
)
print(cars.obs["timepoint_numeric"].dtype)  # float64
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(cars, color = "timepoint_numeric", cmap = "magma")
```

```{python}
cars = cars[
    cars.obs["timepoint_numeric"].notna()
].copy()
```

```{python}
tp = TemporalProblem(cars)
```

```{python}
tp = tp.score_genes_for_marginals(
    gene_set_proliferation="human", gene_set_apoptosis="human"
)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.embedding(
    cars, basis="umap", color=["labels", "proliferation", "apoptosis"],
    wspace=0.5
)
```

```{python}
tp = tp.prepare(time_key="timepoint_numeric")
```

```{python}
tp = tp.solve(epsilon=0.05, tau_a=0.95, scale_cost="mean")
```

```{python}
tmk = RealTimeKernel.from_moscot(tp)
```

```{python}
tmk.compute_transition_matrix(self_transitions="all", conn_weight=0.2, threshold="auto")
```

```{python}
tmk.plot_random_walks(
    max_iter=500,
    start_ixs={"timepoint_numeric": 1.0},
    basis="umap",
    seed=0,
    dpi=150,
    size=30,
)
```

```{python}
ax = tmk.plot_single_flow(
    cluster_key="labels",
    time_key="timepoint_numeric",
    cluster="Activated Naive/CM T",
    min_flow=0.05,
    xticks_step_size=2,
    show=False
)

_ = ax.set_xticklabels(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=90)
```

```{python}
import petsc4py
import slepc4py
```

```{python}
g = cr.estimators.GPCCA(tmk)
print(g)
```

```{python}
g.compute_schur()
g.plot_spectrum(real_only=True)
```

```{python}
g.compute_macrostates(n_states=10, cluster_key="labels")
g.plot_macrostates(which="all", legend_loc="right", s=100)
```

```{python}
g.plot_macrostate_composition(key="labels")
```

```{python}
g.plot_coarse_T(annotate=False)
```

```{python}
g.set_terminal_states(states=["DN T_3", "EM CD8+ T", "Early EM CD8+ T", "Activated Naive/CM T"])
g.plot_macrostates(which="terminal",s=50)
```

```{python}
g.set_initial_states(states=[ "Naive/CM T"])
g.plot_macrostates(which="initial", s=50)
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
```

```{python}
# write macrostates to AnnData
cars.obs["macrostates"] = g.macrostates
cars.uns["macrostates_colors"] = g.macrostates_memberships.colors
```

```{python}
g.compute_fate_probabilities(use_petsc=False)
g.plot_fate_probabilities(same_plot=False)
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
```

```{python}
g.plot_fate_probabilities(same_plot=True)
```

```{python}
cr.pl.circular_projection(cars, keys=["labels"], legend_loc="right")
```


# cellrank using pseudotime as input
```{python}
cars = sc.read("4_car_no_gd_psuedotime.h5ad")
to_remove = ["Product CD8+ T", "Product Mixed T", "Cycling T"]
cars = cars[~cars.obs["labels"].isin(to_remove)].copy()
```

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(cars, n_pcs=15, use_rep="X_pca")
sc.tl.diffmap(cars)
```

```{python}
cars.obsm['X_diffmap'][:, 2].argmin()
```

```{python}
root_ixs = 56349
scv.pl.scatter(
    cars,
    basis="diffmap",
    c=["labels", root_ixs],
    legend_loc="right",
    components=["2, 3"],
    wspace = 0.5
)

cars.uns["iroot"] = root_ixs
```

```{python}
sc.tl.dpt(cars)
sc.pl.embedding(
    cars,
    basis="umap",
    color=["dpt_pseudotime"],
    color_map="gnuplot2",
)

sc.pl.violin(cars, keys = "dpt_pseudotime", groupby="labels", rotation=90, )
```

```{python}
pk = cr.kernels.PseudotimeKernel(cars, time_key="dpt_pseudotime")
pk.compute_transition_matrix()

print(pk)
```

```{python}
pk.plot_projection(basis="umap", recompute=True)
```

```{python}
g = cr.estimators.GPCCA(pk)
print(g)
```

```{python}
g.compute_schur()
g.plot_spectrum(real_only=True)
```

```{python}
g.compute_macrostates(n_states=12, cluster_key="labels")
g.plot_macrostates(which="all", legend_loc="right", s=100)
```

```{python}
g.plot_macrostate_composition(key="labels", figsize=(7, 4))
```

```{python}
g.plot_coarse_T(annotate=False)
```

```{python}
g.predict_terminal_states()
g.plot_macrostates(which="terminal", legend_loc="right", s=100)
```

```{python}
g.set_terminal_states(states=["DN T_2", "EM CD8+ T_3", "Exhausted/Late EM CD8+ T", "CM CD8+ T_1"])
g.plot_macrostates(which="terminal",s=50)
```

```{python}
g.set_initial_states(states=["Activated Naive/CM T", "Naive/CM T"])
g.plot_macrostates(which="initial", s=50)
```

```{python}
# write macrostates to AnnData
cars.obs["macrostates"] = g.macrostates
cars.uns["macrostates_colors"] = g.macrostates_memberships.colors
```

```{python}
g.compute_fate_probabilities(use_petsc=False)
g.plot_fate_probabilities(same_plot=False)
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
```

```{python}
g.plot_fate_probabilities(same_plot=True)
```

```{python}
cr.pl.circular_projection(cars, keys=["labels"], legend_loc="right")
```

```{python}
dn_df.head(10)
```

```{python}
# compute driver genes
naive_driver_df = g.compute_lineage_drivers(lineages=["DN T_2", "EM CD8+ T_3", "Exhausted/Late EM CD8+ T"],
cluster_key="labels", clusters = ["Activated Naive/CM T", "Naive/CM T"])

memory_driver_df = g.compute_lineage_drivers(lineages=["DN T_2", "EM CD8+ T_3", "Exhausted/Late EM CD8+ T"],
cluster_key="labels", clusters = ["CM CD8+ T", "Activated CM CD8+ T", "Early EM CD8+ T"])


# compute mean gene expression across all cells
cars.var["mean expression"] = np.asarray(cars.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
```

```{python}
# visualize in a scatter plot
g.plot_lineage_drivers_correlation(
    lineage_y="DN T_2",
    lineage_x="EM CD8+ T_3",
    adjust_text=True,
    color="mean expression",
    #gene_sets = genes_oi,
    legend_loc="none",
    figsize=(5, 5),
    dpi=150,
    fontsize=9,
    size=50,
    cmap= "magma"
)
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd

# Regex matches gene names starting with MT-, RPL, RPS, MRPL, or MRPS (case-insensitive)
pattern = r"^(?:MT-|M?RP[LS])"

mask = ~naive_driver_df.index.astype(str).str.contains(pattern, case=False, regex=True)
naive_driver_df_filtered = naive_driver_df[mask]

# Map onto the driver DataFrame by gene name
naive_driver_df_filtered["mean expression"] = (
    cars.var.loc[naive_driver_df_filtered.index, "mean expression"]
)

naive_df_expr = naive_driver_df_filtered[naive_driver_df_filtered["mean expression"] >= 0.1].copy()
naive_df_expr["log1p mean expression"] = np.log1p(naive_df_expr["mean expression"])
```

```{python}
mask = ~memory_driver_df.index.astype(str).str.contains(pattern, case=False, regex=True)
memory_driver_df_filtered = memory_driver_df[mask]

# Map onto the driver DataFrame by gene name
memory_driver_df_filtered["mean expression"] = (
    cars.var.loc[memory_driver_df_filtered.index, "mean expression"]
)

memory_df_expr = memory_driver_df_filtered[memory_driver_df_filtered["mean expression"] >= 0.1].copy()
memory_df_expr["log1p mean expression"] = np.log1p(memory_df_expr["mean expression"])
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
sc = ax.scatter(
    x=naive_df_expr["DN T_2_corr"],
    y=naive_df_expr["EM CD8+ T_3_corr"],
    c=naive_df_expr["log1p mean expression"],
    cmap="magma",
    s=5,
    alpha=0.8,
)
fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, label="log1p(mean expression)")

ax.axhline(y=0, color="red", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")  # geom_hline
ax.axvline(x=0, color="red", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")  # geom_vline
ax.set_xlabel("Correlation with DN T fate")
ax.set_ylabel("Correlation with EM CD8+ T fate")
ax.set_title("Driver gene correlations (mean expression >= 0.1)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
```
